scope: Historical PR 784 verification record before the final compaction and Billing candidate. New results do not replace these failures.
text:
## Verification record

- **Baseline unit:** `make test-unit-all` exited 0 at the recorded revision. Rust runner 1320 passed; daemon 137 passed; daemon libraries 3231 passed; app 4036 passed; website 133 passed; CLI 1887 passed, 16 skipped; design system 501 passed. Local development script tests: 25 passed. No failures.
- **Baseline integration:** `make test-integration-rustd` exited 2, with 561 passed and one failed across the completed suites. The authoring suite stopped at 241 passed, one failed: `stopped_history_uses_sequence_index_and_concurrent_sends_keep_unique_sequences` exhausted the API connection pool after its five-second wait. Later suites did not run. This failure does not exempt the candidate from its full checks.
- **Browser evidence:** Desktop first-load loader filled the 900-pixel viewport. During Activity navigation, header and sidebar DOM nodes persisted; the indicator's vertical center offset was zero pixels. Mobile viewport was 390 × 844. No page errors were reported. Screenshots: `/tmp/loader-first-load-desktop.png`, `/tmp/loader-navigation-desktop.png`, `/tmp/loader-first-load-mobile.png`, `/tmp/authorize-ready-desktop.png`, `/tmp/authorize-ready-mobile.png`.
- **Preview timing:** The evidence proxy briefly delayed local reads to expose the pending state. Its delay is now zero. No artificial delay exists in application code.
- **Source reviews:** Adversarial and concurrency reviews found no blocking issue. Shared-code review identified an unused dependency, unused prop and duplicate parsing; all three were removed and re-reviewed without findings. No race detector or new performance benchmark has run; source review alone does not prove race freedom.
- **Initial local acceptance:** `make acceptance-local` was attempted twice. The first attempt stopped at a local socket-port collision. A private environment override selected the confirmed-free port 34463. The second reached runner admission and stopped because the signed ARM toolbox serves 0.64.0 while the branch runner is 0.65.0. Neither attempt reached acceptance tests. Evidence: `/tmp/loader-acceptance-local.log`, `/tmp/loader-acceptance-local-retry.log`.
- **OpenAPI comparison:** The prose edits preserve all 140 operations and every non-prose value of `/private/tmp/loader-openapi-before-human.json`. Its SHA-256 is `0ab83098bf3330676e365f037fff4a961bda62ba1bca5f4557dd1413ee444d1b`, matching the public document at `74a39c60`. Changed prose totals 16,493 words before and 13,532 after. Evidence: `/private/tmp/openapi-human-verification.json`, `/private/tmp/pr784-openapi-original-input-comparison.json`. Comparison against the whole-PR base `499cd98a` separately shows seven inherited schema-path differences, recorded in `/private/tmp/pr784-product-docs-openapi-scope.json`.
- **Architecture coverage:** Astra read all 34 documents, and different Astra reviewers checked each group. Supported factual corrections were repaired and independently accepted. Reports: `/private/tmp/astra-authoring-independent-review.md`, `/private/tmp/astra-auth-independent-review.md`, `/private/tmp/astra-runtime-independent-review.md`, `/private/tmp/astra-authoring-corrections-rereview.md`, and `/private/tmp/astra-auth-runtime-corrections-rereview.md`.
- **First complete local acceptance:** Matching signed toolbox and local GitHub App setup pass all nine preflight checks. The first complete browser run reported 97 passed, 11 failed, one skipped and seven not run; command-line acceptance was not reached. Evidence: `/private/tmp/loader-acceptance-first-full.log`. Setup and two test issues were corrected; the failed run is preserved separately from the retry.
- **Recent repository checks:** `make lint-all` and `make check-version` passed on the preceding candidate. The latest unit retry stopped before a compiled Rust test binary could launch. Verification found 12 documentation-language issues, now corrected. Sequential final checks remain required after the analytics ownership repair. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-final-unit-version-retry.log`, `/private/tmp/pr784-final-orly-verify-retry.log`.
- **Final documentation checks:** `make check-architecture-doc check-documentation-rules` reports 21 architecture self-tests passed, all 482 cited source paths resolved, all 27 published-page pointers resolved and documentation parity clean. The installed prose diagnostic returns no findings. Evidence: `/private/tmp/loader-final-doc-checks-after-style.log`, `/private/tmp/doc-language-diagnostic.json`.
- **Dagger plan review:** Astra identified missing Cloud go/no-go criteria and isolated-service routing proof. Both were added and the full pending spec was re-reviewed without further supported publication blockers. Evidence: `/private/tmp/m232-spec-in-784-rereview.md`. No pilot implementation or Cloud proof is claimed.
- **Earlier full unit and version proof:** `make test-unit-all check-version` exited 0. Rust: 4,688 passed; app: 4,042; website: 133; CLI: 1,887 passed and 16 skipped; design system: 501; local development script: 25. All package coverage gates passed and every version matches 0.65.0. Evidence: `/private/tmp/loader-final-unit-version-retry.log`.
- **Companion documentation:** Docs PR #226 merged the simplified navigation and user guidance. Follow-up PR #227 merged the source-backed runner control and Workers warnings at `879ca12db0a9ecb85ec6e6e01a6736699cafd47e`. GitHub confirmed both merges; no docs PR remains open for this work.
- **Local execution repair:** A private environment override replaced the worktree's existing encryption key, preventing saved model-credential authentication. Restoring the intended key and re-sealing only the two newly created setup bags repaired the local environment. `make acceptance-local SUITE=execution` passed all 10 checks, including install, lease, execute and observe, in 45.7 seconds. Evidence: `/private/tmp/loader-execution-key-fixed.log`. The subsequent full browser run reached 111 passed, one failed, one skipped and six not run. Private-chat reload raced its unacknowledged POST; the test now waits for exact HTTP 202, with held/refused-request negative proofs. Full acceptance remains pending; evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-loopback-full-acceptance.log`, `/private/tmp/pr784-chat-ack-green.log`.
- **Local authorization proof:** Real callback and encrypted-exchange checks preserve one winner, waiting cancellation, finalization and cleanup. Browser-to-terminal approval, signed-out return and Deny passed three journeys each over HTTP and HTTPS. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-cli-loopback-test-ledger.md`, `/private/tmp/pr784-browser-approval-shuffled-coverage.log`, `/private/tmp/pr784-loopback-focused.log`, `/private/tmp/pr784-loopback-https.log`. Final default acceptance remains required.
- **Analytics review repairs:** Astra identified initialization recovery, identity-before-flush and pre-initialization queue ownership defects. The repaired modules pass 106 focused tests with full statement and branch coverage. Five ownership regressions failed before repair. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-analytics-owner-evidence.md`. Final zero-edit review remains required; external PostHog ingestion is outside this proof.
- **Latest conform and generated API proof:** `make harness-verify` passed all seven staged checks. Regeneration retains 140 operations and every non-prose value; candidate SHA-256 is `b5c2d268aa0ffe8f8946ae1d9a28cecd43dc965b33ad43362cafb19ef63f0ffa`. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-final-harness-retry.log`, `/private/tmp/pr784-openapi-final-verification.json`.
- **New login documentation companion:** [Docs PR #228](https://github.com/agentsfleet/docs/pull/228) publishes four updated pages at `395b2ddc5b43cd219859bf8351565c5f27010e85`. After five upstream download failures, a successful download preceded passing verification: 25 tests, site build, links and API checks. Continuous Integration checks are green; one exit-code documentation finding awaits the owner decision. The proposed two-page correction remains unapplied. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-docs-login-verify-network-recovered.log`, `/private/tmp/pr784-docs-babysit-pr228/summary.md`.
- **Current repository unit proof:** `mise exec bun@1.4.3 -- make test-unit-all check-version` passed: Rust 4,688; local development scripts 25; app 4,224; website 133; CLI 1,950 passed and 16 skipped; design system 501. All package coverage gates reached 100%; versions match 0.65.0. Authored documentation changed afterward, so final receipts still need renewal. Integration passed 1,366 tests but its receipt is stale after the added CLI tests. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-final-unit-version-normal-mask.log`, `/private/tmp/pr784-final-integration-frozen.log`.
- **Latest complete local attempt:** Unchanged default `make acceptance-local` failed with 116 passed, two failed and one skipped. CLI acceptance was not reached. Setup turn 42 exceeded the daemon's input reservation; all ten concurrent initial replies completed on the backend, while browser reads stalled behind six HTTP/1.1 event streams. Socket-level attribution remains an inference. Failed fixtures are preserved; no timeout, assertion, history or budget was weakened. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-final-acceptance-default.log`, `/private/tmp/pr784-full-acceptance-continuity-failure`, `/private/tmp/pr784-continuity-context-investigation.md`, `/private/tmp/pr784-continuity-concurrent-investigation.md`.
- **Independent terminal acceptance:** `mise exec bun@1.4.3 -- make acceptance-local SUITE=cli` passed 209 deterministic and 174 live tests, with zero failures or skips. This separate terminal selection does not replace the failed complete default run. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-independent-cli-acceptance-evidence.json`.
- **Product documentation audit:** Initial attempt one of two was blocked by stale loader wording and incomplete independent coverage of inherited changes. The loader wording is repaired; `make check-architecture-doc check-documentation-rules` passed 21 architecture self-tests, 490 cited source paths and 27 published pointers. The remaining audit attempt is reserved for settled inputs. No accepted final documentation audit is claimed. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-product-docs-initial-report.md`, `/private/tmp/pr784-docs-repair-checks.log`.
- **Review boundary:** The current review is terminal, incomplete and nonconverged after three editing cycles. Required acceptance failed; no fourth repair pass or clean final review is claimed. A separate input-budget proposal awaits the owner decision. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-core-review-terminal-record.json`, `/private/tmp/pr784-authoring-budget-follow-up-proposal.md`.
- **Preparation work before optimization:** `make test-unit-rustd-daemon-libs` reached the two new work/isolation tests: one passed and one failed. The fitting-history counter reported `encoded 52480 groups for 2560 source groups`; it counts groups presented to estimators, not measured serialization time, tokens or paid requests. The blocked-summary test passed. This is a regression reproduction, not a passing unit receipt. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-compaction-linear-before.log`.
- **Latest unchanged continuity attempt:** The single-fleet journey passed setup turns 1–50 and processed runtime turns 1–24; the next runtime event stayed `received` until the existing 180-second wait expired. The ten-fleet journey started but has no completed result in the inspected output. Passing setup turn 42 alone does not prove compaction occurred. Full acceptance remains incomplete. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-compaction-acceptance-4.log`.
- **Sandbox evaluation and walkthrough:** The owner supplied an observed Claude cloud environment reference and requested a clean use case to test. [Coding sandbox evaluation](../../architecture/sandbox_evaluation.md) separates observations from explanations, compares service adoption with selective source reuse, and defines repository, compaction, recovery, reattachment and diff verification. SPACE remains a candidate. No SPACE code was copied or deployed. Documentation editing retained lifecycle boundaries and exact source references while replacing the ambiguous encoding-count claim with estimator group visits. No additional review cycle was launched.
- **Evaluation documentation checks:** `make check-architecture-doc check-documentation-rules` exited 0: 21 architecture self-tests, 92 milestone references, 488 cited source paths, 49 tables, 530 columns and 27 published pointers; documentation suites passed 9 and 11 tests, and parity was clean. The final queued-steer clarification is grounded in `docs/architecture/runner_fleet.md:517`; it changes the proposed walkthrough, not execution behavior. Evidence: `/private/tmp/pr784-sandbox-evaluation-doc-checks-2.log`.
